summary.text: The first page of Upper Volta's country report to the 1969 inter-regional seminar on smallpox eradication in Lagos, giving population estimates by age group for 1966 and 1970. sections.title: Page 3

summary.text: Describes programme supervision and assessment in Upper Volta, including days supervisors spent checking vaccination teams and steps taken when performance was poor. It notes that about 1% of primary vaccinations in young children were checked for takes, with revaccination when take rates fell below 95%.

sections.title: Page 4

summary.text: Describes smallpox surveillance in Upper Volta, including 604 reporting sites, weekly reporting with immediate notification of cases, and help from measles and meningitis programmes and village heads. It notes that a new reporting system covering fixed and mobile centres began in January 1969.
